translations.web: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
translations.bsb: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing after his neighbor’s wife.
translations.kjv: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.
translations.asv: They were as fed horses roaming at large; every one neighed after his neighbor's wife.
